theme.description: ArcGIS x Bloomberg Terminal aesthetic. Deep navy/charcoal background, vibrant teal/cyan spatial overlays, and high-contrast white metric cards.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid borders everywhere (border-slate-800). No soft shadows, use sharp tactical edges.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl on dark panels overlaid on the map. NEVER use pure transparent backgrounds under text.

components.white_cards: Use 'bg-white text-slate-950' for key KPI stat cards (Waste tons, Growth %) to make them pop violently against the dark map, satisfying the 'White cards' prompt.
components.buttons: Square edges, border-slate-700 bg-slate-900 text-teal-400 hover:bg-teal-400 hover:text-slate-900 transition-colors duration-200.
components.inputs: Terminal style, bottom border only, flush background, monospaced text.
components.ai_chat: Chat bubbles should be stark: user is white card, AI is dark navy glass with cyan border.

grids_layouts.landing: Full viewport map. Absolute centered hero text 'What should our cities prepare for next?'. One CTA.
grids_layouts.intelligence_dashboard: Absolute edge-to-edge map. Floating 300px sidebar on left (Layers/Insights), floating metrics bar on bottom, floating controls on top right.
grids_layouts.site_suitability: Bento grid of progress bars and constraint lists.
grids_layouts.spacing: Dense internal padding (p-3, p-4) to fit data. Large gaps between floating panels.

motion.panels: Slide in from edges with slight stagger.

accessibility.contrast: Teal on dark navy is AA compliant. Ensure white cards have dark slate text.
accessibility.testing: MANDATORY: add data-testid to every actionable element.

media: Use provided Unsplash URLs for fallback imagery, but rely heavily on live GL map rendering.

3d_libraries.data_layers: deck.gl (for high-performance WebGL overlays, HexagonLayer for hotspots, GeoJsonLayer for routes)

landing_hero_map.description: Satellite map night city - use as fallback bg for landing page.

simulator_neon.description: Smart city neon data - use for AI Future Lab empty state.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required dependencies: yarn add react-map-gl deck.gl mapbox-gl recharts lucide-react framer-motion
Configure tailwind.config.js with the provided dark navy and teal palette.
Implement the Dashboard structure: The map MUST be the root background, with UI elements floating above it.
Design explicit routes/views: Landing (Simple Hero), Citizen Form, and Planner Dashboard (Intelligence + Simulator).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use generic UI centered layouts. This is a dense, edge-to-edge spatial intelligence terminal.
You MUST NOT use complete transparent backgrounds for UI components floating over the map. Always use backdrop-blur-md with semi-transparent backgrounds.
All interactive elements MUST have a data-testid attribute.
Avoid pill-shaped round buttons. Use 0-4px border radius for a tactical, technical aesthetic.
Do not use generic emoji for icons, use Lucide React icons.
Avoid 'transition: all', use specific transition properties.
